items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Natty Dominick said that he wrote on.

ctx.x: He had one of them, you know the slide. You mean the kids didn't play along with the band in the street or anything?

I never saw any, I never saw any of them. Once I heard that they did. Singling and whistling, you know it was a great whistling time. It's good for singing and whistling. Like all them tunes like Sister Kate by Rack, that's Louis Armstrong's tune. That's the same. I don't want to get in no trouble. No, Louis told me that and Natty Dominick said that he wrote on.
Well I heard that before I ever come down.
